summary.text: Scott Petersen is the Republican nominee for Secretary of State. A businessman and former chairman of the Douglas County Republican Party, he campaigned on restoring confidence in Nebraska elections through accurate voter rolls, chain-of-custody procedures and transparency.

paragraphs.text: Describes himself as a Nebraska business owner with over 30 years of experience building and operating businesses.
Served as Chairman of the Douglas County Republican Party and on the Republican State Executive Committee.
